title: 第136章 人道神律专斩功德佛光第135章 西方二圣最后的救命稻草
slug: 先秦炼气两千年世人误闯天家
content_zh:
第136章人道神律专斩功德佛光
这就是一场，赤裸裸的，单方面的，灵魂掠夺！
就像一个果农，摘下果实，为了方便运输和储存，把果皮、果核，这些“没用”的东西，全都扔掉，只留下最甜美的果肉！
而那些残魂的记忆、情感、爱恨情仇，他们之所以为“他们”的一切，就是被当成“果皮”和“果核”，扔掉的东西！
“看到了吗？”
顾长青冰冷的声音，回荡在每一个生灵的耳边，像是一记记重锤，狠狠地砸在他们的心上。
“这，就是西方教的‘慈悲’！”
“他们，根本就不是在拯救你们，他们是在‘吃’你们！”
“他们将你们的灵魂，当成田地里生长的庄稼！你们的痛苦，你们的绝望，你们的祈祷，就是滋养这些庄稼最好的肥料！”
“他们承诺给你们一个虚无缥缈的来世，一个所谓的‘极乐世界’，但作为交换，他们要夺走你们的今生，夺走你们的过去，夺走你们之所以为你们的一切！”
“他们将你们变成一个个没有思想，没有记忆，只剩下纯粹能量的‘果实’，用来壮大他们自身，用来铸就他们那虚伪的，建立在众生白骨之上的，所谓‘功德’！”
轰！！！
顾长青的每一句话，都如同一道惊雷，炸得三界众生，头皮发麻，遍体生寒！
昆仑界中，无数人族，看着光幕中那恐怖的真相，一个个脸色煞白，胃里翻江倒海。
“呕……太恶心了！这哪里是神佛！这分明就是魔鬼！”
“吃人！他们竟然在吃人的灵魂！”
“我……我奶奶当年就是虔诚的信徒，她临终前，还念着佛号，说要去西方极乐世界……难道……难道她……”
一个青年说到这里，再也说不下去，他双目赤红，一拳狠狠地砸在地上，指骨尽碎，鲜血淋漓！
无尽的愤怒和悲痛，席卷了每一个人的心！
而天界废墟之上，准提和接引，在看到那被揭露的真相时，已经彻底傻了。

他们的脑子里，一片空白。
怎么会……
怎么会这样？
他们的度化之法，明明是天道认可的，是他们成圣的根基，怎么会……怎么会是这个样子的？
“不！不是的！这是污蔑！这是赤裸裸的污蔑！”
准提道人终于反应了过来，他像一个被踩了尾巴的猫，声嘶力竭地尖叫起来。
“我们的发心是好的！我们是为了让众生脱离苦海！过程……过程或许有些不完美，但我们的目的是慈悲的！”
“对！对！目的！”接引也找到了救命稻草，他指着那些被吸收的灵魂本源，强行辩解道，“陛下您看，这些灵魂本源，最终，都会在极乐世界中，重获新生！他们会变成一朵朵莲花，无忧无虑，永享极乐！这……这难道不是一种福报吗？”
“福报？”
顾长青被他们这无耻的狡辩，给气笑了。
“一个连自己是谁，从哪里来，有过什么样的爱恨情仇，都忘得一干二净的行尸走肉，也配叫‘新生’？”
“你们所谓的‘极乐世界’，不过是一个更大一点的，用来圈养这些‘灵魂牲畜’的农场罢了！”
他懒得再跟这两个已经彻底腐烂到根子里的家伙废话。
他只是冷冷地看着他们，问出了最后一个问题。
“我只问你们一句。”
“你们的道，从创立之初，究竟是为了让众生，变得更强，更独立，最终不再需要你们？”
“还是为了让众生，变得更弱，更依赖，最终，永远都离不开你们的‘拯救’？”
这个问题，如同一把最锋利的剑，直刺他们大道的本心！
准提和接引，张了张嘴，却一个字都说不出来。
他们的脸色，瞬间，变得惨白如纸。

谎言，被彻底戳穿了。
他们那建立在亿万万众生痛苦和绝望之上的虚伪道统，在这一刻，轰然倒塌！
content_en:
Chapter 136 Humanity and Divine Law Specialize in Killing Merit and Buddha’s Light
This is a naked, one-sided, soul robbery!
Just like a fruit farmer, he picks the fruits and throws away all the "useless" things such as peels and cores for the convenience of transportation and storage, leaving only the sweetest pulp!
And the memories, emotions, loves, hates, and hatreds of those remnant souls, everything they have for "them" are things that are treated as "peel" and "core" and thrown away!
"Did you see that?"
Gu Changqing's cold voice echoed in the ears of every living being, like a heavy hammer hitting their hearts hard.
"This is the 'compassion' taught in the West!"
"They are not saving you at all, they are 'eating' you!"
"They regard your souls as crops growing in the fields! Your pain, your despair, and your prayers are the best fertilizer to nourish these crops!"
"They promise to give you an illusory afterlife, a so-called 'nirvana', but in exchange, they will take away your present life, your past, and everything that makes you who you are!"
"They have turned you into 'fruits' with no thoughts, no memories, and only pure energy left. They use it to strengthen themselves and build their hypocritical so-called 'merit' based on the bones of all living beings!"
Boom! ! !
Every word spoken by Gu Changqing was like a thunderclap, causing all living beings in the three realms to feel numb on the scalp and feel chills all over their bodies!
In the Kunlun world, countless human races looked at the terrifying truth in the light curtain, and their faces turned pale and their stomachs turned upside down.
"Ugh...it's so disgusting! This is not a god or a Buddha! This is clearly a devil!"
"Eating people! They are actually eating people's souls!"
"I...my grandma was a devout believer back then. Before she died, she still chanted the Buddha's name and said she was going to the Western Paradise...could it be...could she..."
When a young man said this, he couldn't go on anymore. His eyes were red, and he punched the ground hard. His finger bones were broken and blood dripped!
Endless anger and grief swept everyone's heart!
On the ruins of the heaven, Zhunti and Jie Yin were completely stunned when they saw the truth revealed.
Their minds went blank.
How could it be...
How could this happen?
Their method of salvation is obviously approved by Heaven and is the foundation of their sanctification. How could it be...how could it be like this?
"No! No! This is slander! This is naked slander!"
The Zhunti Taoist finally reacted. He screamed at the top of his lungs like a cat whose tail had been stepped on.
"Our intentions are good! We are to free all sentient beings from suffering! The process...the process may be imperfect, but our purpose is compassionate!"
"Yes! Yes! Purpose!" Jie Yin also found a life-saving straw. He pointed at the absorbed soul origins and argued forcefully, "Your Majesty, you see, these soul origins will eventually be reborn in the Paradise World! They will become lotus flowers, carefree and enjoy eternal bliss! This...isn't this a blessing?"
"Blessing?"
Gu Changqing laughed angrily at their shameless sophistry.
"A walking zombie who has completely forgotten who he is, where he comes from, and what kind of love and hatred he has had, is he worthy of being called a 'new student'?"
"What you call 'Elysium' is just a larger farm used to raise these 'soul livestock'!"
He was too lazy to talk nonsense to these two guys who were completely rotten to the core.
He just looked at them coldly and asked the last question.
"I just want to ask you one question."
"Your Tao, from the beginning, is to make all living beings become stronger and more independent, and eventually no longer needyou? "
"Or is it to make all living beings weaker and more dependent, and ultimately, forever inseparable from your 'salvation'? "
This question is like the sharpest sword, piercing their true heart!
Zhunti and Jieyin opened their mouths, but not a word came out.
Their faces instantly turned pale as paper.
The lie was completely exposed.
Their hypocritical orthodoxy, which was built on the pain and despair of millions of sentient beings, collapsed at this moment!
